paragraphs: Ammi. “Ammi recited,” Ketubbot 44b; Arukh Hakkatzar: an unordained sage. Rabbah in his name; I think Rava should be read, Ketubbot 48, end of b: Rava says, “Ammi told me.” Tosafot, Zevachim 50a, “He said it”: Rabbenu Tam reads “Ammi said it,” Ammi being a sage’s name. Yevamot 80a: “We heard Ammi say anyone impaired from his mother’s womb”; Bekhorot 18b: Ammi says.
